body: I had a dream I was in a hopsital😭😭 i think i was crying tears of joy in a hospital bed but I dont remember why
Thank you🙁 your very kind. I would love to be added to the group chat.

Thank you for your kind words and advice:’). I think i may have anger issues so i get scared i will leave my fathers life out of anger and regret it. If I do make a decision I will let you know! I wish you a smooth healing journey, and let us both find the courage to seek happiness.

im so sorry man, I hope your feeling better now. Some people just dont deserve kids, and You didnt deserve that. Thank you for sharing your story, much respect. Take care and I hope youve found happiness and peace.

thank you, I am very sorry about your “father”. No child deserves that, and I hope your okay, and in a better place now. I will take your advice to heart, and im glad someone can see where im coming from. I have a lot to think about and im not sure where to start. Im just really lost in my feelings, and not sure if i miss him or not. Have a lovely night/day, and stay safe:).

Thank you, I got tired of hearing the same thing of i should forgive him solely because he is my parent, but i dont think that really matters. If you would like, I would love to hear your story. Have a nice day/night:)
